description: Static catalogue of binary env-driven feature flags that do NOT have a per-feature state file. apply_config.py projects each flag's bundle value (true/false) to an env var entry inside .ai-playbook/feature-flags.env using the env_var + value_on + value_off mapping below. The consumer must source that file in their shell init (direnv .envrc, bashrc, fish init) for the flags to take effect at runtime.

flags.label: LLM routing: strict mode
flags.description: Fail loudly when a task class has no matching model in litellm-router.yaml. When false, the router falls back to defaults and emits a warning. Strict mode is recommended for production but can be noisy during local development.

flags.label: Weekly telemetry report issue
flags.description: Opt in to the weekly rule-event telemetry digest posted as a GitHub issue (label `telemetry-report`). When ON, apply_config seeds .github/workflows/rule-event-report-weekly.yml (seed-only — never clobbers your edits) and bootstrap creates the label. Empty windows (0 events) are skipped, so no noise. Turn off by deleting the workflow file. Default OFF.
